description: The contractor shall provide all labor, supervision, tools, equipment and transportation necessary to provide, install and maintain washers and dryers, on a rental basis, on Langley AFB, VA in accordance with (IAW) this performance work statement (PWS). The washers and dryers will be rented from the contractor, in new condition, and the contractor shall also perform quarterly inspections/preventative maintenance, and perform repairs on an as needed basis. See attachments for additional details.
